header: Who paid for the part of this that was not billed to anyone
text: The retrofit of the Marnauhof district heating substations was carried out with support from the Fonds für Betriebliche Energiewende under the Wärmewende Ost programme 2025 to 2028. The views expressed on these pages are those of Falkensteg Gebäudetechnik GmbH alone.
note: Project number WWO-2025-0417. The measurement data behind the efficiency figures was collected by the Forschungsverbund Gebäudetechnik Austria and is published under the project's own reporting obligations.
